question: Should Crabbox accept fal Compute as a built-in direct SSH lease provider through https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/693, and should the funded-provider live proof gate remain mandatory before merge?
rationale: Adding a billable remote provider creates new config, credential handling, ownership, cleanup, and live-provider support surface; automation should not decide product acceptance or waive the repository's funded-provider proof gate.

options.title: Require proof before merge
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the linked PR to resolve conflicts, correctness findings, and full redacted create/use/destroy proof before landing.

options.title: Waive funded proof explicitly
options.body: A maintainer can accept first-use risk and land after ordinary review without full funded fal lifecycle proof.

options.title: Defer built-in support
options.body: Pause or close the linked PR and leave this issue as the canonical request until fal API and ownership details are ready.

recommendation.title: Require proof before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the linked PR to resolve conflicts, correctness findings, and full redacted create/use/destroy proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent provider lifecycle, credential-redaction, cleanup, and release/registry history make this the strongest available owner signal for the product/proof decision.
